examples.arabic: هي قررت تشتريه فورًا وترجّعُه ليه في الجامعة بكرة.
examples.english: She decided to buy it immediately and return it to him at the university tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Heya qarraret teshtareeh fawran we teragga'o leeh fel gam'a bokra.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: علي شرح له مشكلته، وعمو محمود رد: "بالظبط! أنا معايا كتاب الدرس اللي أنت عايزه ده، خده. أنا بروح الشغل كل يوم بعد القهوة. أنت لازم تدرس للامتحان كويس جداً." علي رد: "ألف شكر يا عمو! مع السلامة دلوقتي، أنا لازم أروح أذاكر بيه فوراً!"
examples.english: Aly explained his problem to him, and Uncle Mahmoud replied: "Exactly! I have the lesson book you want, take it. I go to work every day after the coffeehouse. You must study very well for the exam." Aly responded: "A thousand thanks, Uncle! Goodbye for now, I must go study with it immediately!"
examples.transliteration: Aly sharah lu mushkeltu, w ammo Mahmoud radd: "Bel-zabt! Ana ma'aya ketab el-dars elli enta ayezuh da, khoduh. Ana baruh el-shoghl kull yom ba'd el-ahwa. Enta lazim tedrus lel-emtihan kwayyes geddan." Aly radd: "Alf shokr ya ammo! Ma'a el-salama delwa'ty, ana lazim aruh azaker beih fawran!"
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: قررت اني اشتريه فورا لاني حبيته جدا
examples.english: I decided to buy it immediately because I loved it very much
examples.transliteration: Qarrart inni ashtareeh fawran le'inni habbetu giddan
